summary_ja: 届出の懈怠または承認基準不適合の場合に、金融庁長官が内部評価方式の承認を取り消せることを定める。
summary_en: Allows the Commissioner to revoke approval for the internal assessment approach where a required notification was neglected or approval standards are no longer met and use of the approach is inappropriate.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that has obtained approval for the use of the internal assessment approach has failed to make the notification under item (ii) of paragraph (1) of the preceding Article, or falls under item (iii) of that paragraph, and the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency finds it inappropriate to calculate the risk weights of securitization exposures using the internal assessment approach, the Commissioner may revoke the approval under Article 239.
